package rulefixtures

import (
	"gorm.io/gorm"
	"gorm.io/gorm/clause"
)

// scenario for row_by_row_upsert_loop: Upsert-style writes executed row by row inside loops instead of batched.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Rule292PositiveRecord struct {
	ID   int    `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Name string
}

func scenario292Positive(db *gorm.DB, items []Rule292PositiveRecord) error {
	for _, item := range items {
		if err := db.Clauses(clause.OnConflict{
			UpdateAll: true,
		}).Create(&item).Error; err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
